ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L. 561-1 through L. 561-50-1 and R. 561-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier, 'CMF'); Law No. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II Law on transparency, anti-corruption and modernisation of economic life); Articles L. 561-46 through L. 561-49 CMF establishing the beneficial owner (UBO) register and declaration filing; Decree No. 2017-1094 of 28 June 2017 on the UBO declaration; Order of 26 July 2017 on the standard UBO declaration form; Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on information accompanying transfers of funds; Council Regulations (EU) No. 269/2014, No. 2580/2001 and No. 2015/1750 on restrictive measures; Regulation (EU) 2018/1673 on countering money laundering by criminal law; ACPR, TRACFIN and DG Trésor AML/CFT and financial sanctions guidelines.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (the French UBO register is not open to the general public; access is restricted to judicial, police, customs and tax authorities, TRACFIN, ACPR, and specifically authorized regulated entities pursuant to Articles L. 561-47 and R. 561-57 CMF, confirmed by the Conseil d'État after the ECJ judgment in C-37/20 Luxembourg Business Registers v. ABLV Bank)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent registrar in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Extract of the beneficial owner register of the foreign parent or a sworn UBO declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent corporate registry in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies of the future SAS President and all direct and indirect UBOs identified at or above 25%
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin or in France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign notarial acts

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney granting incorporation authority to the French counsel/incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin or French notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / no pending liquidation of the foreign parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the foreign parent's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed banking institution of the incorporator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Lessor or licensed domiciliation company in France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized or certified document; French notarization where a residential lease is used

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and ongoing screening of every director, officer, UBO and shareholder at or above the 25% threshold against: (i) United Nations Security Council Consolidated Lists; (ii) EU Council restrictive measures lists under Regulations (EU) No. 269/2014, No. 2580/2001 and No. 2015/1750; (iii) French national asset freeze orders published by the Ministry of Economy (DG Trésor/MINEFI); (iv) OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions lists, applied as international banking and correspondent compliance policy; (v) French domestic PEP classification under Articles R. 561-18 to R. 561-18-3 CMF covering French and foreign political exposed persons, family members and close associates; identification of PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification and senior management approval under Article L. 561-10-2 CMF; any unusual or complex transaction pattern must be reported to TRACFIN under Article L. 561-15 CMF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: No standalone statutory name reservation system exists in France. Availability screening is performed via: (i) the national companies registry database at data.inpi.fr (INPI, Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle); (ii) infogreffe.fr (RCS records maintained by the Greffes des tribunaux de commerce); (iii) the single official incorporation filing portal 'Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises' operated by INPI at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; and (iv) publication of the mandatory legal notice (annonce légale) in an authorized Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL). The same name may be rejected if identical or confusingly similar to an existing RCS entry or a registered trademark of national or EU effect.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Law No. 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (Loi Toubon) and Article R. 123-53 of the French Commercial Code, the corporate name (dénomination sociale) of a French SAS must be expressed in Latin characters; a name in non-Latin script must be accompanied by an official transliteration or translation filed with the RCS. The name must be stated in French in all instruments used in France; foreign-language names are acceptable only when written in the Latin alphabet and when the transliteration does not create confusion with an existing registered name or a protected mark.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banking monopoly terms: 'Banque', 'Crédit', 'Caisse des dépôts', 'Caisse' used in a banking sense — require prior authorization from the ACPR under Article L. 511-5 CMF
Insurance terms: 'Assurance', 'Assureur', 'Prévoyance', 'Mutuelle' — require prior ACPR authorization

Regulated legal/accounting professions: 'Avocat', 'Notaire', 'Huissier de justice', 'Commis-saire de justice', 'Commissaire aux comptes', 'Expert-comptable', 'Société d'expertise comptable' — require prior order from the competent professional body
Public authority terms: 'État', 'République', 'Ministère', 'Mairie', 'Préfecture', 'Police', 'Gendarmerie', 'Administration' — prohibited if they create an implication of public sovereign status
Geographic terms such as 'France', 'République française', or regional/commune names used in a way likely to mislead as to national origin or official affiliation
Terms implying regulated financial intermediation: 'Fiduciaire', 'Société fiduciaire', 'Placement', 'Épargne' where a monopoly or regulated activity is indicated

Any token that is identical or confusingly similar to an existing RCS name or a protected EU/national trademark in the same activity class, including aviation-related marks where likelihood of confusion exists
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France provides no statutory administrative 'reservation' of a corporate name; protection accrues upon successful RCS registration. If the Guichet unique or the Greffier rejects the incorporation dossier on name grounds: (1) obtain the written reasoned rejection decision (décision motivée); (2) file a petition (requête) to the President of the competent Tribunal de Commerce within 15 days under Article L. 123-1-1, paragraph 5 and Article R. 123-90 of the French Commercial Code, requesting judicial authorization of the constitution; (3) attach the draft articles of association, the rejection notice, the name availability search (data.inpi.fr / infogreffe.fr) and evidence of non-confusing character; (4) the President issues an ordonnance which may authorize registration as filed or impose a modified name; (5) refile the complete dossier through the Guichet unique immediately after the ordonnance; (6) any adverse order may be appealed to the Cour d'appel within 15 days of service. A rejected name frequently becomes repairable by adding distinctive elements such as a corporate suffix, industry descriptor or a registered trademark element.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible. Under Article L. 227-4 of the French Commercial Code, an SAS must state a registered office (siège social) in its bylaws; the seat may legally be (a) the domicile of the President, (b) a leased commercial office, or (c) a domiciliation company authorized under Articles L. 123-11-1 and R. 123-167 et seq. of the Commercial Code, provided the office is genuine and effective for third parties. A virtual office alone is therefore sufficient only for the corporate seat. For the present ISIC 5621 airline inflight catering kitchen, a virtual office is NOT permissible as the sole establishment because the activity requires a physical, licensed production facility (agrément sanitaire / déclaration sanitaire under hygiene regulations), customs bonded status (régime de l'entrepôt sous douane for import/movement food handling), and operational airport ramp access; the licensed kitchen and storage premises must be real, occupied and verifiable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Very High. Quantified risk: over 90% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of operation. Mandatory programmed inspections are conducted at least annually by the Direction départementale de la protection des populations (DDPP/DGAL) for food hygiene and HACCP compliance; the Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI) performs bonded warehouse and goods-movement audits where entrepôt sous douane status is held; the airport operator and airline counterparties conduct ramp and kitchen security/quality audits; and failure to maintain verifiable commercial substance triggers immediate suspension or withdrawal of the catering license and access permits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 (SAS) and L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general incorporation provisions)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) via the Guichet Unique operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) and the M0 form (déclaration de création d'entreprise)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum capital required; capital may be set at €1. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid up at incorporation, with the remainder within 5 years. No escrow account is required unless capital exceeds €225,000 or contributions in kind necessitate a commissaire aux apports.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the shareholders hereby subscribe to the share capital of the SAS as set forth in the Articles of Association, and that the initial capital contributions be paid in accordance with law. RESOLVED: That the registered office be established at [address], France, and that the President and any other officers be appointed as named in the Articles. RESOLVED: That the President is authorized to complete all formalities, including publication of the legal notice, filing with the Guichet Unique, and registration with the Commercial Court. RESOLVED: That the board approves the opening of a corporate bank account and the execution of all necessary documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) – online database
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary search on the INPI trademark and company name database to ensure the proposed SAS name is not identical or confusingly similar to existing registered names. Optionally reserve the name via the Guichet Unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, submit a revised name with a justification of distinctiveness or appeal to the INPI within 2 months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (optional) or private deed; legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts (Articles) including corporate purpose, share capital, governance rules, and appointment of the President. All shareholders must sign the document. If capital exceeds €225,000 or contributions in kind are made, a commissaire aux apports must be appointed.
required_dossiers: Proof of capital contribution (bank certificate or notarized deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Statuts are incomplete, rectify the missing clauses and re-sign. If a commissaire aux apports is required, obtain the report before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Legal Notice (Avis de Constitution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal announcement journal (Journal d'Annonces Légales) in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a notice containing the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, and duration. The notice must appear in a legal gazette authorized for the department.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice is rejected, correct the content and republish. Ensure the notice is published before filing the incorporation dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Dossier with Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete dossier electronically via the Guichet Unique, including the Statuts, proof of publication, capital deposit certificate, and identification of the President. The portal transmits the dossier to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
required_dossiers: Declaration of no criminal record (for President)
Power of attorney if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is queried, correct the deficiencies within 15 days. If the query is unresolved, the application is rejected; re-file after rectification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration and Issuance of Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Greffe registers the company and issues the Kbis extract (official certificate of incorporation). The company obtains its SIREN number and is legally constituted.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is delayed, contact the Greffe to expedite. If the Kbis contains errors, request correction within 1 month.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Départementale de la Protection des Populations (DDPP) / Direction Régionale de l'Alimentation, de l'Agriculture et de la Forêt (DRAAF)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agrément Sanitaire (Sanitary Approval) for food handling and catering

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique / Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration (Déclaration) under the French Environmental Code (Code de l'environnement) for catering activities with moderate environmental impact; full EIA required if capacity exceeds thresholds (e.g., >300 meals/day or significant emissions).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Articles R.214-1 et seq. of the Environmental Code and EU Directive 91/271/EEC; VOC emissions per Directive 1999/13/EC; waste handling per ISO 14001 and French waste regulations (Code de l'environnement, Articles R.541-1 et seq.).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (avis de la commission de sécurité) from the local fire department; structural load inspection by a bureau de contrôle (e.g., Socotec, Bureau Veritas); workplace clearance (médecine du travail) and compliance with occupational health and safety regulations (Code du travail).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a fully convertible eurozone regime with complete capital account convertibility and current account convertibility. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted and expeditious, subject only to standard corporate documentation, beneficial ownership verification, and FATCA/CRS reporting. No capital controls or FX surrender obligations apply to legitimate corporate transactions; remittance hurdles are negligible for EU-parented entities and moderate for non-resident ownership structures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds is required under French law. Exporters may retain foreign currency receipts in offshore or domestic FX accounts and convert freely through authorized banks at market rates. Statutory timeline is zero; voluntary surrender is permitted but not mandated. All export documentation must reference commercial invoices and comply with transfer-pricing rules where applicable.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) are licensed and supervised by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR). Cross-border digital EMI operations are feasible only through French or EU licensing under the Payment Services Directive and e-money framework. Offshore-only digital EMIs face prohibitive legal constraints including minimum capital of EUR 350,000, strict ongoing reporting, and mandatory local agent or partnership requirements. Not recommended for high-volume aviation-related payments without a French entity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding and e-KYC are fully permitted for French SAS entities via major commercial banks using video verification and electronic signatures. Physical presence of directors is not mandatory for standard onboarding but may be required for initial beneficial-owner interviews or enhanced due diligence triggers. All directors must provide valid government-issued ID and proof of address.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or undisclosed UBO exceeding 25% threshold
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate registry extract (Kbis), UBO declaration form, source-of-wealth affidavit, and independent verification from corporate service provider

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction links or PEP involvement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence file including PEP screening report, transaction pattern analysis, and third-party business verification confirming legitimate airline catering operations

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent source of funds for capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorizing injection, shareholder funding agreement, audited financial statements of injecting entity, and bank reference confirming clean transaction history

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions or shareholder loans to French SAS accounts must be executed via SWIFT MT103 using the entity's IBAN and BIC. Purpose codes include 'CAP' for capital contribution or 'LOAN' for intercompany funding. All wires require supporting documentation (board resolution, shareholder agreement, tax identification confirmation) and are subject to automated AML screening and beneficial ownership checks. Verification is mandatory within 48 hours of receipt.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for airline inflight catering operations utilize SWIFT MT103 for wire transfers or Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) through correspondent banking networks. Settlements reference specific supplier contracts, purchase orders, and delivery confirmations. Intra-EU transactions may use SEPA Instant or SEPA Credit Transfer; international routes require full SWIFT messaging with proper purpose codes and compliance with export control declarations where applicable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency forwards for hedging multi-currency exposures
Cross-currency swaps for long-term funding and balance-sheet management
FX options for asymmetric risk protection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual filing of financial statements (comptes annuels): balance sheet, profit and loss statement, annexes, accompanied by the shareholder decision approving accounts and, if applicable, the statutory auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Guichet Unique (INPI online portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the close of the fiscal year; for a 31 December fiscal year-end, by 30 June of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may be penalized by fines up to EUR 15,000 for the company, an injunction from the President of the Commercial Court with astreinte, and after repeated non-compliance, administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner declaration (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs) - update or confirmation upon any share transfer or change in effective ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Event-driven, not annual: file within 15 days of any change in beneficial shareholding; no separate annual filing is required in the absence of such change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update the UBO declaration within the 15-day window subjects the entity to a fine of up to EUR 10,000 and the legal representative(s) to a fine of up to EUR 5,000; persistent default may be recorded and used as grounds for judicial strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Verification / audit of corporate statutory registers (share register, minutes of decisions, meeting records) by the statutory auditor or a credentialed corporate secretary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate governance record; findings are available to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce on inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Conducted concurrently with the annual statutory audit; must be completed before the annual accounts are filed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or incomplete statutory registers may trigger a formal notice from the greffe and a fine for irregularity of up to EUR 10,000; egregious defects may lead to involuntary dissolution or strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SAS is subject to mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when, at the end of the financial year, at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded: total balance-sheet assets above EUR 4,000,000; net turnover exclusive of tax above EUR 8,000,000; average number of permanent employees above 50. Separate rules impose audit for SASs that consolidate or control legal entities, or that are themselves controlled by another undertaking.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) governs the preparation of the individual statutory annual accounts of the SAS. Where a consolidated package is prepared for a group, IFRS is permitted for the consolidated accounts; the statutory individual accounts remain French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not require a separate annual UBO renewal statement. The beneficial-owner declaration is filed at incorporation and must be re-filed within 15 days after any event changing the list of effective owners, including share transfers, changes in voting rights or changes in statutory control. The annual deposit of the financial statements includes a presentation of corporate facts; any inconsistency with the registered UBO list may be challenged by the Registry. The SAS must therefore confirm, on an annual basis and under the authority of its President, that the UBO list in the statutory registers is complete and current, and file an updated form if the ownership has changed.

Registre des décisions des associés (minute book of shareholders' decisions and written consultations)
Registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées (meeting minute register if shareholders' meetings are physically held)
